Resolves #20089

Excludes raw `tickets`, `pull-requests`, and `discussions` archive routes from primary `getSitemapXml()` and `getLlmsTxt()` outputs by default (`includeArchives = false` / `--include-archives` opt-in) while keeping `getContentRoutes()` exhaustive for SPA route tables, and omits duplicate `id`, `title`, `state`, and `labels` rows from `Portal.view.news.tickets.Component#frontMatterToHtml` (plus removes the unused `getBadgesHtml` helper and duplicate frontmatter parse/badge loop in `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs`).

Change class: `restoration` (`fix`). `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline check-file-sizes, check-relative-links, lint-staged, and pre-push guards ran`. Self-authored drift probe (`git log origin/dev --since="2026-10-24T01:07:10Z" --name-only`): zero intersection.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit specs for `generate.mjs` and `Portal.view.news.tickets.Component` + live CLI measurement against `.github/RELEASE_NOTES` and `learn/tree.json`) → L2 required (all 3 ACs of `#20089` are in-repo SEO generator, frontmatter renderer, and JSDoc contracts).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` (`getSitemapXml and getLlmsTxt exclude raw ticket, PR, and discussion archive routes by default` and `getSitemapXml and getLlmsTxt include archive routes when includeArchives is true`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.spec.mjs` (`frontMatterToHtml omits id, title, state, and labels while keeping author and timestamps`, `frontMatterToHtml returns empty string when only header-rendered fields are present`, and `modifyMarkdown renders state and labels in .neo-ticket-labels under H1 without duplicating them in frontmatter`) |
| AC-3 | `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` (`@module buildScripts.docs.seo.generate`, `collectAllRoutes`, `getSitemapXml`, `getLlmsTxt`) and `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/Component.mjs` (`frontMatterToHtml`) |
